neighbours.label: the verbs cut and pull as sudden physical action (they cut the fence, pull over)
fire: Later they cut the wire and crept across the yard.
I think I should pull over and check the tire.
Without a word she cut the rope with her knife.
Sometimes I just want to pull over and scream.
At dawn the raiders cut the chain on the gate.
He had to pull over because of the hail.
That night we cut the lock and took the bikes.
Then you pull the lever and jump clear.
quiet: Later they walked along the wire and looked across the yard.
I think I should call a mechanic and check the tire.
Without a word she folded the rope and put it away.
Sometimes I just want to sit quietly and think.
At dawn the raiders were asleep near the gate.
He had to wait outside because of the hail.
That night we counted the bikes in the shed.
Then you read the manual and go home.

notes: Weak: other verbs of throwing and kicking gave mixed results in the probes (' threw' peak ' in' 0.37, 'grabbed' 0.06, 'tossed' 0.02).
